items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: And this boy, Vincent, I forget his other name, but he was running the dance down there.

ctx.x: Was it a party or something?

Yeah, it was a house party. That's for the whites, you know. And they treated us so nice, so after we knocked off, we knocked off at twelve o'clock, we made that two dollar, two and a half, I just remember what it was. So when I got home, I told my mom, I said, yeah, mom. So I gave her the two dollars. I said, you see, you say they're going to throw me out. I said, they didn't throw me out. I said, they gave me two dollars. I said, that's two dollars. So she said, well that's mighty nice. It's like that. So all…
Who was the trumpet for that? Will Phillip. That same Will Phillip.
